newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq soars as techs continue return to favor.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq soars as techs continue return to favor.

text.p: The Nasdaq market extended its rebound to two straight sessions Friday, the market's composite index rising 23 points, or 1.9 percent, to an unofficial 1236.7 on the strength of computer-related and biotechnology issues.
"The market shook off the IBM downgrade very well. There was strong performance across the board. The techs were at an oversold level," said Tim Grazioso, Cantor Fitzgerald manager of Nasdaq trading.
Merrill Lynch lowered its near-term rating on International Business Machines Corp Friday to neutral from buy, according to a source at the brokerage firm.
IBM fell 2-1/4 to 129-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Nasdaq composite fell 12.8 points for the week, including Monday's 28-point tumble.
Market breadth Friday was 2416 gainers, 1759 decliners and 1112 issues unchanged. Unofficial volume 677 million shares and the session yielded 29 new highs and 189 new lows.
Among Nasdaq shares, Sybase jumped 2-5/8 to 15-3/4, Adtran added 4-1/2 to 28-1/4 and Centocor rallied to 36-1/8 from 31-1/2.
